name: race_minute
description: 0.9.0's minute a life in Tide Race (release page): offline, Tide Race chosen in the hub, Race the caretaker, my seat played by the plan bot, which waits out every window in both builds. At 3:00 of the race (tick 10800) my crew is on wave 4 and the rival crew on wave 6 in both builds (the 0.9.0 caretaker's early calls and 0.8.0's are level by then); the match held there, my crew three lives down and the rival crew two (the logged lives setters, the only staging), the race line under the resource strip, the picture that line alone (the strip's gold differs between the builds' plans): my clock and the rival's with the lives' part, +30 s and +20 s in 0.8.0 (above), +180 s and +120 s in this build. The same steps run on both builds.

steps.assert: Game.wave == 4 and Game.rival_line().begins_with('Rival · Wave 6 · 20 lives') and Game.lives == 20
steps.msg: 3:00 in: my crew on wave 4, the rival crew on wave 6, no life lost yet on either

steps.assert: node('RivalLine').visible and node('Hud').race_clock_line().ends_with(' s') and Game.rival_line().contains('18 lives')
steps.msg: my clock and the rival's with the lives' part
